items.title: Al Chez interviewed by Monk Rowe, New Hartford, New York, February 13, 2019
items.q: oh yeah there’s me playing with Prince

ctx.x: You got to stand next to some pretty good saxophone players too over the years.

I did. I did. Besides the saxophone players I did about two years, all the way to, more than that, I played with Tower of Power for a while, which was the saxophone players — man they had some guys. You know, they had some guys. But even Letterman I remember doing — we played with so many different people that, and this is weird saying it and I don’t mean to sound like egotistical by this, but I forgot half of the people that I played with because it was our job and every day it was something really unique and…
Yeah. You should have kept a diary.
